```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent-decl "<!ENTITY internal 'expanded-value'>">
  %ent-decl;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?target-pi data="processing-instruction-value"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns" xmlns:custom="http://example.org/custom">
  <!-- Leading comment explaining the root structure -->
  <child custom:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags> &entities; inside.
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record+)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Value 1">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Value 2">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<database xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/db" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Comment: Testing multiple namespaces and entity expansions -->
  <record xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <![CDATA[
      <html:div>HTML fragment inside CDATA</html:div>
    ]]>
    &ent2;
  </record>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'Parameter Entity Expansion'>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment 1: Before CDATA block -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw text with <markup> and &ersands;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <!-- Comment 2: After CDATA block -->
  <item>&ent;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to,from,heading,body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY writer "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY recipient "Jane Doe">
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose" mode="test"?>
<note xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:note="http://example.org/note">
  <!-- Important metadata note -->
  <note:to>&recipient;</note:to>
  <note:from>&writer;</note:from>
  <heading>Reminder</heading>
  <body>
    <![CDATA[
      Don't forget to escape characters like <, >, and &.
    ]]>
  </body>
</note>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base;Derived">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css" title="Compact"?>
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Section container with multiple entities and CDATA -->
  <section>
    <![CDATA[
      <svg:svg width="100" height="100">
        <svg:circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40"/>
      </svg:svg>
    ]]>
    &derived;
  </section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro SYSTEM "external.ent">
  %ext-macro;
  <!ENTITY local-ent "Local Entity Text">
]>
<?xml-timestamp date="2023-10-01"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inventory" xmlns:ns1="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.org/ns2">
  <!-- Inventory list containing mixed CDATA and entities -->
  <ns1:item id="a1">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed content with brackets [[]] and quotes "" ''.
    ]]>
  </ns1:item>
  <ns2:item id="a2">&local-ent;</ns2:item>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (description, task*)>
  <!ELEMENT description (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT task (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY milestone "Beta Release">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-space preserve?>
<project xmlns="http://example.org/project" xmlns:p="http://example.org/project/params">
  <!-- Project tracking document -->
  <description>
    <![CDATA[
      Project description including &milestone; reference inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </description>
  <p:task>&milestone;</p:task>
</project>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY auth "Administrator">
  <!ENTITY token "ABC123XYZ">
]>
<?target data="Processing instruction payload with special chars <>&'\""?>
<config xmlns="http://example.org/config" xmlns:cfg="http://example.org/config/settings">
  <!-- Configuration parameters and authentication tokens -->
  <cfg:setting name="user">
    <![CDATA[
      User profile: &auth;
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
  <cfg:setting name="token">&token;</cfg:setting>
</config>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file*)>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-frag "<!ENTITY archived-entity 'ArchivedData'>">
  %dtd-frag;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="archive.css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/archive/meta">
  <!-- Archive block with nested elements, CDATA, and entities -->
  <meta:file id="f1">
    <![CDATA[
      File header: [ID-001]
    ]]>
  </meta:file>
  <file>&archived-entity;</file>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE log [
  <!ELEMENT log (entry*)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY warning "WARNING: Low memory">
  <!ENTITY error "ERROR: Core dumped">
]>
<?xml-log-level value="debug"?>
<log xmlns="http://example.org/log" xmlns:diag="http://example.org/log/diagnostics">
  <!-- Diagnostic log containing mixed structures -->
  <diag:entry level="warn">
    <![CDATA[
      Stack trace:
      at functionA (file.c:123)
      at functionB (file.c:456)
    ]]>
  </diag:entry>
  <diag:entry level="err">&error;</diag:entry>
  <entry>&warning;</entry>
</log>
```
